mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an active monetary tightening cycle that increases equity discount rates, compressing valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with consecutive monthly FEDFUNDS increases, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and UNRATE indicate monetary tightening coinciding with labor market stress, which amplifies recession risks and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with concurrent FEDFUNDS and UNRATE increases, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining retail sales (RSAFS) during late-cycle expansions signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate revenue visibility, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of late-cycle periods with RSAFS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 5 days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with consecutive PAYEMS increases, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1100 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces overall economic activity and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where HOUST < 1100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and rises in FEDFUNDS indicate supply shocks amplified by monetary tightening, increasing inflation expectations and reducing equity valuations over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with INDPRO decline and FEDFUNDS rise, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, FEDFUNDS exceeding 2.0% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 2.0% during tightening cycles, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year windows.
